items.mainDefect: error() calls _(error_short) on a variable, so makemessages can't extract the payload error strings for translation.

secondary.defect: "Github" is spelled inconsistently and should be normalized to "GitHub".

items.mainDefect: MAX_ALLOWED_REQUESTS in src/theme/config.js is 150 and should be lowered to 100.

secondary.defect: The requestAnimationFrame wrapper around performSearch in src/components/search.js should be removed.
sanitizeInput in src/utils/helpers.js should be renamed to sanitize.
src/analytics/tracker.js uses Date.now() where performance.now() should be used.
src/api/client.js uses GET for /api/data where POST should be used.
Form handling may map body.name to the wrong field (for example, body.title) instead of input[name="name"].
